system.description: This hexagonal, brilliant-red hearthstone allows the bearer to walk safely over any generally horizontal or gradually inclined surface, including water, lava, mud, ice, quicksand, on top of a field of grain or on any similar terrain. The bearer can move over these surfaces without injury, slowed movement or an increased chance of slipping or falling. However, this stone does not allow its bearer the ability to walk on air, walk up walls or on ceilings. The stone only allows horizontal movement over a liquid or an at least somewhat solid surface.
